name: Lux Copper Corp. Ltd
summary: Lux Copper Corp. Ltd explores for minerals in the United States, targeting copper, zinc, lead and barium. It holds interests in the Ambler Project in the Amber Mining District of the Northwest Arctic Borough, Alaska, and the Baird Project in the eastern Baird Mountains, Alaska. It was incorporated in 2024 and has its base in Subiaco, Australia.
